name: maca DownList
author: macas

sections.description:
Developed by maca development.

maca DownList helps you publish downloadable file lists on your WordPress site. Organize files into lists, show them in a grid or list layout, and let visitors download files through tracked links.

Unlimited lists, Media Library files, shortcode and block, PDF view/download buttons, and an opt-in front-end credit line. More information: maca DownList.

Features

  • Unlimited file lists

  • Unlimited files with title, description, manual thumbnail, and download file (Media Library)

  • File type label with icon on the front end

  • Optional More information link per file

  • PDF files: View (browser) and Download buttons

  • Download counts in admin (Files and Lists)

  • Media Library picker for download files and thumbnails in admin

  • Grid or list layout (default under maca DownList → Settings)

  • Shortcode: [maca_downlist list="your-list-slug"] or [maca_downlist] to show all lists grouped

  • maca DownList List Gutenberg block

  • List display heading and intro text per list

  • Built-in multilingual user guide in admin (eight languages)

  • Admin and front-end translations: English, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian (Bokmål), Finnish, German, French, Spanish

  • Optional Powered by maca DownList credit on front-end lists (opt-in under Settings)

Pro version

This WordPress.org package is the free, fully functional maca DownList — unlimited lists and files, with no license check.

maca DownList Pro is a separate plugin (download from maca DownList Pro) with advanced delivery and admin features. License activation is not included in this WordPress.org build (WordPress.org policy).

Included in this free plugin:

  • Unlimited file lists and unlimited files

  • Shortcode and maca DownList List Gutenberg block

  • Show all lists on one page ([maca_downlist] or list="all")

  • Grid or list layout, PDF View + Download, manual thumbnails

  • Simple download counts in admin (Files and Lists)

  • Media Library storage, list heading and intro text, built-in user guide (eight languages)

  • Powered by maca DownList credit is opt-in and off by default (leave unchecked in Settings to hide it)

Pro adds (separate download — see comparison on maca DownList Pro):

  • Automatic thumbnails for image and video files

  • Built-in video player (stream in the list)

  • Protected file storage (in addition to Media Library)

  • Custom download and information link styling (colors, hover, font)

  • Guest comments and CAPTCHA (reCAPTCHA / Cloudflare Turnstile)

  • Access restrictions (IP / country blacklist)

  • Full download log (IP, country, action) — free shows simple download counts only

  • File versioning

  • Configurable max upload size

  • Pro support in wp-admin

Privacy and external services

Files are stored in the WordPress Media Library. Download links are handled on your site.

On activation, deactivation, and uninstall, the plugin may send a small lifecycle event to api.maca.se (site URL, plugin/WordPress/PHP version, locale). Optional deactivation feedback from the Plugins screen is sent the same way. No license checks and no visitor download content. maca Hub status endpoints only respond when maca Sec provides a site key (optional companion plugin).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the maca-downlist folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via Plugins → Add New.

  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.

  3. Create lists under maca DownList → Lists.

  4. Add files under maca DownList → Add New: title, description, thumbnail, download file, and assign at least one list.

  5. Review maca DownList → Settings (default layout and optional front-end credit).

  6. Place [maca_downlist list="your-list-slug"] on a page or use the maca DownList List block.
sections.faq:
What is included in this plugin?

Unlimited lists, unlimited files, manual thumbnails, Media Library storage, grid/list layout, shortcode and block (single list or all lists), PDF view/download buttons, simple download counts in admin, and the built-in guide.

How do I show a list on a page?

Use [maca_downlist list="brochures"] where brochures is your list slug, or add the maca DownList List block. To show every list on one page, use [maca_downlist] or list="all".

Can a file belong to multiple lists?

Yes. Assign multiple lists when editing a file.

How do I change the layout?

Add layout="list" or layout="grid" to the shortcode, or choose layout in the block. The default is under maca DownList → Settings.

How do I upload or replace a download file?

Edit a file under maca DownList → Files and use Select file or Replace file (WordPress Media Library).

Does this plugin phone home?

Lifecycle events (activate / deactivate / uninstall) and optional deactivation feedback go to api.maca.se to help improve the product. Download files and visitor traffic stay on your site. This WordPress.org build does not validate licenses.

How do PDF files behave on the front end?

PDF downloads show View and Download buttons. Other file types show a single download button unless customized.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes. maca DownList Pro adds video playback, download logging, guest comments, access restrictions, custom link styling, protected storage, and more. It is a separate plugin from maca DownList Pro — not installed from WordPress.org.

Can I activate a Pro license in this plugin?

No. WordPress.org does not allow paid license activation in the directory package. Install maca DownList Pro from maca.se after purchase; your lists and files in the database are kept when you switch.

  • Readme: Free vs Pro comparison; product pages https://maca.se/maca-downlist/ and https://maca.se/maca-downlist-pro/
